reasons.emulator:
EVE template ctxsdw.yml: Citrix SD-WAN (CTX SD-WAN) appliance.
VERIFIED 2026-08-29: boots to login prompt in 10.8s with this profile.
Kernel console type: telnet (serial).
reasons.config_console:
W177-G1 (2026-08-30): Citrix SD-WAN never presents a command line on its
console - measured, not assumed. 25 minutes after a full boot the serial log
ended at kernel time 48.68s and the VGA framebuffer (read over RFB) showed the
SAME frozen text, with none of the newlines/`admin`/`help` we sent appearing on
it, i.e. the guest processed no input at all. EVE-NG agrees by omission: none of
its 30 config_*.py scripts covers ctxsdw. The console itself stays "telnet" and
still works for watching the boot - only CONFIG read/write is refused, and it is
refused with this reason instead of a misleading "no dialect for vendor citrix"
(the same vendor's nsvpx has a full working dialect). Delete these two keys if a
future build offers a console login; nothing else has to change.

settings.config_console_reason: Citrix SD-WAN is administered over its web UI; its console shows boot messages only and never offers a login.
